metadata.title: A Tale and Two Recipe | Bamboo Shoot Pickle and Stir Fry
metadata.description:
This video features a story about the spirits of forest, a bamboo shoot pickle recipe and a simple stir fry recipe.

Bamboo is a giant grass and is found ubiquitously all around the world. One of the oldest plants on earth, bamboo has uses from cradle to coffin. Bamboo plays an important role in daily life of rural people especially tribal in numerous ways from agricultural implements to housing to food. 
The bamboo shoot has high nutritive content as it has high quantity of vitamins, minerals and amino acids. 
Bamboo shoot is very popular in Northeastern India and is processed differently by different communities and consumed. 

Different processing methods such as fermentation, roasting, boiling, blanching or canning is done to remove toxic compounds from them. 

In this video I bring to you two bamboo shoot recipe and an interesting story.
